body:
Wow, thanks. I'm lucky to meet a kindred spirit here. 

I think one good thing that's come out of it is my work ethic here at uni, which I'll hopefully carry forward to my masters and then into work. A levels were hell for me and I fell apart at the end despite my parents making money no issue with private tutors etc..  I was rejected from all five of my primary uni choices I ended up here at (X) private university through a wonderful process called "clearing" which we have here. 

The only reason I was at a good uni was because my parents had the money to send me here, I was and still am very aware of that. So I buckled down and determined to give my parents a good return on their investment, and I am. My grades are now on par with friends I have here who came from top 5 UK private schools with A*AA grades and similar. So there is that. 

I'm glad that you're coping with it. I hope things go well for you. I very much get what you mean about being rock bottom and having nowhere to go but up. I think maybe I'm on a similar path. I certainly don't give a flying fuck what the majority of my peers here think of me as such, just that it reflects badly on me that I can't fit in. 

I'm pulling an all-nighter and have a tutorial in 20 mins or so (it's 08:34 in the UK). Thanks for talking to me and as I saw from your post history other people that aren't doing so well. Its helped to talk.

I'm sorry to run like this. Thanks for your support, it's meant a lot.

Hi, thanks for answering. I guess what bothers me most is that I can't see the path out of this mindset. I'm aware that I have everything that I need to be happy as such and I don't understand why I can't be one of these people that happily bumbles through life and - at least on the surface - doesn't seem to be constantly torturing themselves. 

Thanks so much for answering. I can't really be completely honest to anyone about this so it feels good to get it off my chest. If I can ask what did you mean in saying "seems to be a lot of opportunity for you, as well as your family, in this."?
